# BusinessDay Nigeria

> > Nigeria's premier business, finance, and economic news platform covering markets, investment, policy, and African business developments.

BusinessDay provides comprehensive coverage of Nigerian and African business news, with focus on capital markets, economic policy, infrastructure development, and investment opportunities. The publication serves as a key resource for understanding Nigeria's business environment and its role in the broader African economy.

## Key Topics

- Nigerian Capital Markets
- African Investment & Venture Capital
- Economic Policy & Regulation
- Infrastructure Development
- Banking & Financial Services
- Securities & Market Regulation
- Emerging Markets
- Startup Ecosystem
- Corporate Governance
- Regional Economic Analysis
- Private Equity
- Urban Development
- Trade & Export Development

- [Spns Consulting report reveals product knowledge gap among banks staff](https://businessday.ng/markets/article/spns-consulting-report-reveals-product-knowledge-gap-among-banks-staff): Spns Consulting study exposes banking staff product knowledge deficiencies
